item.title: 31: Daily Halacha: Lighting the Menorah in Public Places
item.description:
Is lighting Hanukkah lights in the synagogue part of the original misvah? The Gemara and Geonim know only lighting at home. The Rabbi traces the synagogue custom to the 12th century and the Rishonim, the Meiri, Ritva and others, and gives several reasons for how it developed.
Daily Halacha — Hanukah Dayan Daniel Kada
Part of the Daily Halacha – Hanukah series.

item.title: 32: Daily Halacha: Lighting the Menorah from Right to Left or Left to Right
item.description:
Do you light the Hanukkah menorah from left to right or right to left? The Shulhan Arukh says to begin with the new candle on the far left and turn rightward, following the Talmudic principle of turning right and marking the new miracle. This is Sephardi practice, and the Vilna Gaon and some Ashkenazim differ.
Daily Halacha — Hanukah Dayan Daniel Kada
Part of the Daily Halacha – Hanukah series.
